info.name: SpotOn Reserve Availability Time Clock Entries API

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the location.

params.name: updatedAtStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start of the update range.

params.name: updatedAtEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end of the update range.

params.name: inStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start for shift clock-in times.

params.name: inEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end for shift clock-in times.

params.name: outStart
params.description: Inclusive RFC 3339 start for shift clock-out times.

params.name: outEnd
params.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 end for shift clock-out times.

items.docs: Retrieve all time clock entries for a location within a specified date/time range, filtered by update time, clock-in time, or clock-out time.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for the location.

params.name: timeClockEntryId
params.description: The unique identifier for the time clock entry.

items.docs: Retrieve a single time clock entry by its unique identifier for a location.
